content: कारक {%a.%} (-रिका|{%f.%}) [कृ-ण्वुल्] (Usually at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>) .²1 Making, acting, doing, performing, creating, doer <ab>&c.</ab> स्वप्नस्य कारकः <ls>Y. 3. 150</ls>, <ls n="Y.">2. 156</ls>; वर्णसंकर- -कारकैः <ls>Bg. 1. 42</ls>; <ls>Ms. 7. 204</ls>; <ls>Pt. 5. 36</ls>. कारका मित्रकार्याणि सीतालाभाय सोऽब्रवीत् <ls>Bk. 7. 29</ls>. .²2 An agent. .²3 Intending to act or do. .{@-कम्@} .²1 (In <ab>Gram.</ab>) The relation subsisting between a noun and a verb in a sentence, (or between a noun and other words governing it); there are six such Kārakas, belonging to the first seven cases, except the genitive: (1) कर्तृ; (2) कर्मन्; (3) करण; (4) संप्रदान; (5) अपादान; (6) अधिकरण. .²2 That part of grammar which treats of these relations; {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} syntax. .²3 Water produced from hail. .²4 An organ (इन्द्रिय); जगाद जीमूतगभीरया गिरा बद्धाञ्जलीन्संवृतसर्वकारकान् <ls>Bhāg. 8. 6. 16</ls>.

कारिका .²1 A female dancer. .²2 A business, or trade .²3 A memorial verse, or a collection of such verses, on grammatical, philosophical, or scientific subjects, {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} Bhattojī Dīkṣitaʼs Kārikās on grammar; called वैयाकरणसिद्धान्तकारिका; सांख्यकारिका. .²4 Torment, torture. .²5 Interest.
